Name: Indulgence Period
Description: My drag persona, Indulgence, is stepping into 2026 as the newly crowned Mx. F.L.A.G. 2026 (Fits Like a Glove), and I could not be more excited for what this year has in store. I am entering this reign with an influx of ideas, creativity, and a deep desire to create spaces for communities and individuals who may feel they do not have a place to belong. I want to be the microphone of change—amplifying voices, creating opportunities, and giving people the space they deserve to be seen, heard, and celebrated. Through events and experiences that bring the community together while encouraging everyone to express themselves in their truest form, I hope to make this year one of connection, visibility, authenticity, and unapologetic self-expression.

Name: Amethyst Rain
Description: In 2025, Amethyst Rain took the stage and left the judges in awe of her passion, drive and performance.  Although she has been with F.L.A.G for several years, her Journey as F.L.A.G.'s 2025 Title Holder speaks loudly. Serving with a heart full of gratitude and passion, while leading with a strong voice and formidable presence, Amethyst managed to raise over $7,000 in donations that benefit Charities and organizations such as; Seven Hills Behavioral Health, The Steel Yard, Rhode Island Pride, New Urban Arts and more. Her main focus during her Title year was built on inclusivity, community building, diversity, elevating local talent, and raising funds for charities. She, along with her Sash Bothers, have achieved just that. While a lot of her work was front facing and visible, behind the scenes she was a helping hand and a guiding force; elevating, building and inspiring as she went. Amethyst's mission, strong will and drive will remain intact and ready for the next organization in need of funds, the next individual in need of guidance and the next group of people in need of a voice. With her strong support and love for the people, she will continue to bring the Rain.

Name: Boggy Fryer
Description: Also known as The Cape Cod Boot Boy, he is a New Englander, vers dom, and a boot and glove lover for years.  At 19 years old, he entered the fetish community and was collared by his now husband Robby. Nick 'Boggy' Fryer discovered his love of gloves early, when he watched supervillains and bad guys in comic books and television shows menace their victims with leather gloved hands and longed to unlock that power for himself. Welcomed into the NE kink community by others and founding his own leather family, Boggy Fryer is a Cape Cod washashore since 2007 and attends many local kink and leather events. He is a podcaster, amateur voice actor, script writer, and loves to spend his time underwater or in a playroom.  In addition to being Mr. FLAG 2019 and 2020,, he founded the Mr. Snowbound Photo Contest.

Name: Diva Corvette
Description: Diva Corvette won her first title in Connecticut in 1997 as "Entertainer of the Year". In 2002 she was elected as the first Empress to reign in MA. Alongside Emperor Tim Davis the Imperial Court of Massachusetts, they raised over $35,000 for local charities. During her reign, Corvette received awards for her fundraising efforts in Massachusetts, Connecticut, Rhode Island, New York, Vermont, Nebraska, Ohio, Lexington, Louisville, Cincinnati, Chicago, Buffalo and Texas. Corvette has been an ardent supporter of the leather and fetish community and has hosted, judged or performed at Mr and Ms FLAG, Mr Boston Leather, Ms Boston leather, Mr Providence Eagle, Mr NE Rubber, Leather Sir and Leather Boy, Fetish Fair, Fetish Masquerade Ball, Ocean State leather, Folsom Street East, Northeast Drummer, Mr New England Bear, Mass Bear and Cub and Mr New England Puppy. In 2010 Corvette served as President of the Board of Directors for the Imperial Court of Massachusetts.  In 2011, Corvette won the title MS FLAG, the first drag queen to win a leather title in New England. In 2012 she won the Rene Beaudoin Memorial Glove Award for her community service in the New England area. In 2015, Corvette stepped up to serve on the Board of Directors for the local leather group Bay State Marauders for two years. In 2017 Corvette was pinned into Mamas leather family as "Mama's Diva Corvette." In 2017, Corvette won Miss GNI Lace. Corvette is co-producer of Mr Providence Eagle. Currently Corvette is an active member of the New England Rubber Men, Bay State Marauders, FLAG and the Imperial Court of Massachusetts.

Name: Mark Badway
Description: Born December 4th, 1969 - October 23rd, 2014, deceased.  Mark Badway was from North Providence, RI.  He held the title of Mr. FLAG 2010, was a member of FLAG and the Leather Boys of New England.  A professor of physics at Austin University by trade, he was a warm and genuine man who was taken too soon.  He was 45 when he passed.

Name: Michael White
Description: Michael came all the way from Washington DC to enter the FLAG contest, and won, showing that our contest is internationally based, meaning that anyone can enter from the US and beyond. Michael was very active in his community during his title year.  We are very proud to have him as a Mr. FLAG titleholder.

Name: Joe Roy
Description: Joe, being our very first titleholder, won the title in August of 2003.  Though Joe identifies as a woman, she prefers to take on a masculine role and presence, and chose the Mr. title for her title year. Setting a precedent for future contests showing that the FLAG title is open to everyone.  Joe was also a big activist for same-sex marriage (At the time, not yet legal in the United States) and was pivotal in the process its legalization in Massachusetts.
